snippet.title: Great Journey Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Operation: Great Journey is live! Celebrate Halo 2's 20th anniversary with the Delta Arena playlist featuring iconic maps, the new MA5K Avenger, Forge updates with third-person mode, and more.  

Unlock the Thremaleon armor inspired by Rtas "Half-Jaw" 'Vadum, and upgrade to the Premium Pass for exclusive rewards like the Veteran SRS99 sniper model and Damascus Alchemy coating. 

Jump in now and relive the legacy! 💥 

https://aka.ms/GreatJourneyLaunch 

#halo #haloinfinite #operationgreatjourney
